title: The Cover of Marseille's old port
author: Lena Voss
blurb: Juniper Sterling, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
